candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic; the ledger is a read-only consumer of GET /v1/demo/runs with no write side effects
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section: 'on the candidate demo, see a queued, a waiting, and a finished run in the right sections and open the finished one frozen.' A LIVE browser walk of that journey needs an authenticated demo session, which is minted by the entry path (#1313 anonymous session / #1319 dual entry) — not built yet and owner-gated on the Supabase anonymous toggle. So the slice-level verification here is the deterministic component suite that folds run rows in each lifecycle state into the three sections and asserts a finished run opens frozen; the live candidate walk composes at the wave gate (#1322) once the entry path exists. This mirrors the wave's 'built against captured artifacts, live-mode at the gate' scoping.

journeys.name: run-ledger-three-sections-render
assertions: the In-Progress sub-tab renders three sections — waiting on you, running, finished — with runs sorted so those needing the seller are at the top
a queued run (no events yet) is visible in the correct section, proving the panel reads the polled read model and not the event stream
each finished run is labelled with its actual terminal state (completed, completed-after-decline, cancelled, expired, timed out, failed, worker-lost) — never a single generic 'done'
opening a finished run opens it frozen via the existing per-run replay path

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'built bundle carries the new panel.' The new run-ledger panel must be discoverable in the built JS output, not only in apps/demo source.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' This is an apps/demo panel replacement that reads an already-merged endpoint; no database schema or persisted-shape change.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'assert the previous In-Progress panel is not left half-wired to the mock it no longer has.' The mock state the old panel read is deleted in the mock-layer slice (#1320), NOT here — so this slice's rollback assertion is that reverting restores the prior panel intact and does not strand it against a mock this slice did not remove.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
deleting the mock layer or its other consumers — that is #1320, not this slice; here the old panel is replaced but the mock is left intact
minting or wiring an anonymous demo session — that is #1313/#1319; this slice consumes an authenticated session, it does not create one
adding, changing, or multiplexing any server route — the ledger is a polled read of the existing GET /v1/demo/runs; a per-shop multiplexed stream is explicitly out of scope
computing any run's terminal state client-side — the label comes from the persisted run row the read model returns
any retry-in-place affordance — a failed run's card points back to Decisions; there is no retry that would skip the approval gate
